about: The stock photos chosen from Wikimedia Commons for each image slot (slot id = <slug>.<view> or scene.<id>). Re-download them with: python data/curated/scripts/fetch_stock_images.py --picks. crop = [left, top, right, bottom] as fractions of the original; blur = boxes (same units) made unreadable, for number plates. Representative photos of the model, not of the fictional vehicles.
